motd: Welcome to the Weftmarches. Hollow Wake MMO is a foundation, not a game yet: expect placeholder shapes, rough edges and frequent changes.

items.title: The launcher is here
items.body: The launcher installs the game client from GitHub Releases, checks every download against the release manifest and keeps itself up to date. Pick Stable for hand-cut releases or Nightly for the newest build.

items.title: Running your own server
items.body: Point the Server field at any Hollow Wake MMO server. The default, 127.0.0.1:7777, is a server running on this computer: start one from a checkout with dotnet run --project src/HollowWake.Server.Host.

items.title: What to try
items.body: Make a character, walk out of Ninewells, take the quartermaster's offer, and fight the hobs by the hedgerow. Weaves sit on the number keys; V switches between the isometric and third-person cameras.
